notes: The full 336-hour LP with time_limit = 0.01 s. HiGHS stops on kTimeLimit long before it has a solution, so this is a pure numerics failure: the model, the data and every policy key are untouched and the same config with a sane time_limit is the baseline case. Fix = raise time_limit (Tier A). Because HiGHS may have no primal solution to hand back, pypsa's assign_solution can raise; the runner catches that, reads HiGHS' own model-status line out of highs.log and still reports TIME_LIMIT rather than ERROR - see adapters/pypsa_toy/runner.py status_from_highs_log.
